description: This Java class 'DeviceOwnerFragment' is an Android Fragment used for demonstrating device management APIs for device owner scenarios. It provides UI controls to modify global device settings such as auto time and time zone, and to set or clear a preferred launcher, interfacing with Android's DevicePolicyManager and managing preferences stored in SharedPreferences.

classes.name: DeviceOwnerFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that demonstrates the management of device settings and preferred launchers via device owner APIs.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the DeviceOwnerFragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view references and binds event handlers after view creation.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Obtains the DevicePolicyManager system service when the fragment attaches to an activity.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Releases references to system services when detaching.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Retrieves current settings and updates the UI upon fragment resumption.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentSettings
methods.description: Updates UI based on current global device settings and preferred launcher.

methods.name: getBooleanGlobalSetting
methods.description: Reads a boolean global setting from Settings.Global.

methods.name: setBooleanGlobalSetting
methods.description: Sets a global setting using DevicePolicyManager.

methods.name: setCheckedSafely
methods.description: Sets the checked state of a CompoundButton without firing its listener.

methods.name: loadPersistentPreferredLauncher
methods.description: Loads the preferred launcher package name from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: savePersistentPreferredLauncher
methods.description: Saves or clears the preferred launcher package name in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: setPreferredLauncher
methods.description: Sets a selected launcher as the preferred launcher via DevicePolicyManager.
